okay, my overall opinion of this model:

as caveats this is in RHD, UK, night time and wet roads, and comparing against Nevada model

overall vibe: leisurely Sunday driver, safe but slow especially on highways. prepare to get tailgated a lot

local roads:
- very good lateral, handles turns and unwinds very well, parked car avoidance about the same, traffic lights maybe if there's other cars stopped in other lanes otherwise rolls them
- longitudinal slow downs very good for T junctions and roundabout, but fails to speed up to appropriate speeds even when the road is clear

highways:
- lateral good as ever, lane changes good
- longitudinal very bad slows down to 45mph on a completely clear 3 lane highway, unable to judge slowing for lead vehicles because they're all going faster than me

recommended for: MADS/DEC users
not recommended for: experimental pure blood users
this model has the best lateral yet, but I still gotta give it to Nevada/DTRv6 for experimental long for running at sustained speed limits

For me in my EV6, TCPv3 has been the best model for consistent driving. Good at lights, but struggled with stop signs. 90° turns are a hard no, but local highways with lights, side streets, and interstate all felt great. I noticed coming out of an SCC-M slowed turn it does not accellerate out and resume speed limit along with other issues with maintaining set speed/changing when posted speed limit changes. Overall the most human feeling lateral I've seen yet. Granted I'm pretty new... Lol
Lane changes seem more sluggish and I had right hugging. Wind was strong but mostly from the right, which is weird
